s1.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: The patient is a 32-year-old woman
The skin condition has progressively worsened
The condition involves 90% of her body surface area
There are widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques on the trunk and extremities
The plaques involve 30% of the body surface area
The patient has sparse and short eyebrow hairs
The patient has coarse and brittle scalp hairs
Skin biopsy showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography showed nodal swelling, with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end
